hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that replaces Uniswap v4's standard concentrated liquidity with a bonding curve backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes using a custom curve, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all pool accounting, bypassing standard tick-based pricing. Reverts on beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate to prevent unproductive positions.
